name: HT01d. Tested HIV Negative Referred for HIV Prevention Services
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM mamba_flat_encounter_hts_card_v2 a
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
  ON mdp.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE
  a.encounter_datetime >= ':startDate'
  AND a.encounter_datetime <  ':endDate'
  AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  AND a.linked_prevention_services = 'YES'
  AND (a.final_result IS NULL OR a.final_result='NEGATIVE')
  AND a.hts_delivery_model LIKE '%Facility%'
;
